instruction: Create a new folder named "workspace_dev" on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command: [ -d ~/Desktop/workspace_dev ] && echo 'Directory exists.' || echo 'Directory does not exist.'
